boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on corridors in the practical Queens-campus orbit, each with one source-backed reason to stop.

cards.title: Hillcrest Library
cards.subtitle: Union Turnpike corridor
cards.notes: Use the branch’s current location listing to plan a library stop on Union Turnpike; check the location page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop on the Union Turnpike corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens Public Library lists Hillcrest Library at 187-05 Union Turnpike in Flushing.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s location page for current hours and services.

cards.title: Cunningham Park
cards.subtitle: Union Turnpike corridor
cards.notes: Enter from the Union Turnpike side and use the official park page to choose a facility or trail activity that fits your visit.
cards.short_summary: A large NYC Parks destination with natural areas and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks identifies Cunningham Park as a 358-acre Queens flagship park with mapped natural areas and facilities.
cards.access_notes: Use the NYC Parks page for facility information and current park updates.

cards.title: Kissena Park
cards.subtitle: Kissena Boulevard and Booth Memorial Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the park’s paths or locate the velodrome from the Kissena Boulevard and Booth Memorial Avenue side; follow posted park guidance.
cards.short_summary: A park corridor with lake views, trails, and a dedicated cycling track.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists Kissena Lake, hiking trails, and the Kissena Velodrome among Kissena Park’s features.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists facilities and highlights; observe posted rules at each facility.

cards.title: Meditation Garden
cards.subtitle: 56th Avenue and 141st Street, Kissena Corridor
cards.notes: Find the planted garden near 56th Avenue and 141st Street, then use its benches and curved paths for a quiet, daytime pause.
cards.short_summary: A named planted stop along the Kissena Corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks locates the Meditation Garden near 56th Avenue and 141st Street and notes its benches and curved pathways.
cards.source_title: Kissena Park & Kissena Corridor Hiking Trails, NYC Parks
cards.access_notes: Access from the Kissena Corridor trail network; use daylight and follow park signage.

cards.title: Queens Botanical Garden
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Plan a garden walk from the Main Street entrance and review the seasonal admission calendar before you go.
cards.short_summary: A 39-acre garden destination on Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens Botanical Garden lists its address as 43-50 Main Street and publishes seasonal hours and admission information.
cards.source_title: What to Do / See, Queens Botanical Garden
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday; seasonal hours and admission terms are published by the Garden.

cards.title: Queens Public Library at Flushing
cards.subtitle: Main Street and Kissena Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the Main Street branch as a destination on the Flushing corridor; confirm today’s hours and any service changes online first.
cards.short_summary: The Flushing branch anchors Main Street at Kissena Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens Public Library lists its Flushing location at 41-17 Main Street, at Kissena Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: The library location page publishes current daily hours.

cards.title: Queens Museum
cards.subtitle: Flushing Meadows Corona Park corridor
cards.notes: Reserve an individual ticket or arrange a group visit before going, then enter through Flushing Meadows Corona Park’s museum area.
cards.short_summary: A museum stop in Flushing Meadows Corona Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens Museum identifies its location as the New York City Building in Flushing Meadows Corona Park and provides visit reservations.
cards.access_notes: Individual and group visit details, including reservation requirements, are on the museum’s visit page.

cards.title: New York Hall of Science
cards.subtitle: 111th Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the 111th Street address to reach NYSCI in the park, and review current exhibit access and ticket details before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on science-museum destination on 111th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: NYSCI lists New York Hall of Science at 47-01 111th Street in Corona.
cards.access_notes: Check NYSCI’s current visitor information and ticket availability before visiting.

cards.title: Queens Zoo
cards.subtitle: 111th Street corridor
cards.notes: Enter through the park path on 111th Street and buy a date-specific ticket ahead if you need guaranteed entry.
cards.short_summary: A wildlife destination reached from the 111th Street park entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens Zoo says its entrance is via the Flushing Meadows Corona Park path on 111th Street and recommends advance date-specific tickets.
cards.access_notes: The zoo lists 53-51 111th Street and provides transit and entrance directions.

cards.entity_name: Jamaica Center for Arts and Learning
cards.title: Jamaica Center for Arts and Learning
cards.subtitle: Jamaica Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check JCAL’s public-program calendar, then use a Jamaica Avenue visit to see an exhibition or attend an all-ages arts program.
cards.evidence_claim: JCAL describes itself as a Queens arts organization offering public programs and accessible education in visual art, music, dance, and theater.
cards.source_title: Jamaica Center for Arts and Learning
cards.access_notes: Consult JCAL’s calendar for event-specific access, timing, and any registration requirements.
